item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President presently establishes and prescribes the composition and appointment procedures of an advisory commission; this is internal executive organization, with no substantive change to legal rights or eligibility.","evidence":"There is established the President's Commission on Catastrophic Nuclear Accidents"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President must later select a commission member as chairperson, an internal staffing and leadership assignment that creates no external legal consequence.","evidence":"The President shall designate one of the members of the Commission as Chairperson"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Commission is directed to conduct a future study concerning possible compensation mechanisms; the segment neither awards compensation nor dictates a later legally binding compensation outcome.","evidence":"The Commission shall conduct a comprehensive study"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Commission must later report recommendations, agencies must provide requested assistance, and the chairperson may staff the Commission; these are reporting, coordination, and internal administrative functions without a dictated substantive legal result.","evidence":"Each such agency is directed, to the extent permitted by law, to furnish such information, advice, or assistance"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"Executive officials must furnish administrative support, members may receive compensation and expenses under existing law, presidential advisory-committee functions are delegated, and the Commission receives reporting and termination deadlines; these are internal administrative and housekeeping provisions rather than newly imposed external legal consequences.","evidence":"The functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act that are applicable to the Commission, except the function of reporting annually to the Congress, shall be performed by the Administrator of General Services."}]}
